title: Teal & Royal Blue Soft Silk Saree with Gold Zari Floral Border
description: Embrace timeless elegance with this stunning Teal and Royal Blue Soft Silk saree. Featuring a rich, traditional gold zari border with intricate floral and paisley motifs, this saree is lightweight, breathable, and easy to drape. Perfect for festivals, weddings, and grand family gatherings.

title: Radiant Pink Rhinestone Silk Saree
description: Elevate your ethnic wardrobe with this stunning vibrant pink saree. Featuring delicate floral motifs embellished with sparkling rhinestones, this lightweight drape offers a perfect blend of modern elegance and traditional charm. Comes with an unstitched blouse piece.
